source_title: Bigg Boss 20: Manish Goel Suffers Asthma Attack After Gullu, Yung DSA's Heated Clash
source_excerpt:
Actor Manish Goel suffered an asthma attack while trying to stop a heated argument between fellow contestants Gullu and Yung DSA in the latest episode of Bigg Boss 20. The disagreement reportedly turned physical, prompting Manish to step in and prevent the two contestants from hurting each other. Although he managed to intervene, his own health soon deteriorated, leaving other housemates concerned.
ALSO READ: Gullu Evicted From 'Bigg Boss 20'? Netizens Demand Elimination After Physical Fight With Yung DSA
The incident took place during a captaincy task in which Mahhi Vij was removed from the competition and appointed as the sanchalak. The task involved different shapes placed in the garden area, with contestants required to move into whichever shape Bigg Boss announced.
During different rounds, Yung DSA and Gullu failed to secure a place inside the designated shapes and were eliminated from the task. This led to a heated exchange between the two contestants, which soon escalated.
A promo reportedly shows Scout pulling Gullu out of the board, after which Yung DSA remarks, “Bail buddhi ko ek number kheecha hai.” The argument then intensifies, with Gullu and Yung DSA seen pushing each other.
As the situation became physical, Manish stepped in to separate them. However, while trying to stop the altercation, he suffered an asthma attack.
#ManishGoel 😭🙏🏻 #YungDSA aur #Gullu ki haatha pai mein Manish rela gya😭🤣 We want justice for manish goel #BiggBoss20 https://t.co/5ac8CDW6IZ
As Manish struggled in the garden area, Asif Khan, Uditi Singh and Mahhi Vij came forward to help him. Mahhi also asked Bigg Boss to send him to the medical room so he could receive attention.
Despite Manish's deteriorating condition, the argument between Gullu and Yung DSA reportedly continued. Manish later requested Yung DSA not to shout, saying "Yung shaant hoja please." [Yung, please remain quiet]
